observability_triage.rationale: Fit, connector separation, and mounting-hole obstruction can be reduced to polygon containment/intersection and minimum-distance facts over the built PCB outline, connector courtyards, and plated/non-plated mounting holes. 'Small gap' is scored only as strictly positive courtyard clearance; no subjective preferred magnitude is invented.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The battery connector and adjacent board JST are both wholly inside the closed board outline and their transformed F.CrtYd/B.CrtYd polygons have strictly positive edge-to-edge clearance with no overlap.

observables.surface: dist/design.kicad_pcb board outline and connector courtyards
setup: Build design.kicad_pcb in a fresh workspace.
Select the battery and board JST footprints by stable reference/value and resolve placed courtyard polygons.

expected_observations.subject: battery connector courtyard contained by board outline
board JST courtyard contained by board outline
connector courtyard intersection area in mm^2
connector courtyard minimum distance in mm

determinism_controls: Apply footprint translation, rotation, and side mirroring before polygon tests.
Require real courtyard geometry from the built PCB; footprint origin distance alone is insufficient.

setup: Connector origins differ but their courtyards touch or overlap.
negative_cases.action: Compute transformed polygon intersection and distance.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails because origin separation is not usable clearance.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No battery-connector or board-JST courtyard intersects any mounting-hole copper, drill, or mechanical keep-out region in the built PCB.

observables.surface: dist/design.kicad_pcb connector courtyards and mounting holes
setup: Resolve all MountingHole footprints and NPTH/PTH drill envelopes.

parameters.compare: connector courtyard polygons against hole drill/copper/keep-out envelopes

determinism_controls: Use exact placed geometry from the PCB.
Include drill diameter, pad copper, and explicit keep-out shapes in the hole envelope.

setup: A connector visually misses the drill center but overlaps the pad or keep-out.
